input.content:
## Description

Queue rows now show host, runner, model, lifecycle, and last-event columns, replacing the single-character runner mark with readable names. Narrow widths shrink model and last event before name, host, and runner.

- Runner labels come from the daemon runners.list answer over configured gateway labels, which also seed the client before the first answer and after a restart.
- Model aliases resolve at draw time; an unmapped alias shows the raw string, never a catalog guess.
- The host column appears when several hosts are available, even if every row uses one.
- Gateway env values and helpers stay out of runners.list, covered by a redaction test.

Wide:

```text
●!  billing-sync     edge-1  Gateway A  model-x  suspended needs input
◐   docs             local   Claude              running   working
✓   bulksess         local   Bulk                running   turn done
```

## Testing

- [x] `bun run typecheck` passes
- [x] `bun run test` passes (1840 pass, 2 skip, 0 fail; e2e 48/48)
- [x] `bun run lint` passes
- [x] New tests added for new functionality

## Context

Independent Codex review returned 3 findings; all are fixed in this branch.
